name: docs-root-migration
description: Move work to root specs and remove docs

spec.why: The owner wants docs removed completely, root ./specs for executable work, and one current documentation home in the wiki.

requirements.text: Discover canonical root specs in workspace/worktrees with canonical precedence and legacy-only read fallback.
Remove docs without a symlink; retain relocated evidence and closed pack bytes through a complete path/hash map.
Consolidate all four full research sources into their current wiki concepts; retain originals only as archived provenance.
Retarget current wiki sources, entry documents, and shipped/installed skills while preserving historical artifact bytes and corpus.
Serve current work from specs in the local library, open owner review, and record actual checks and independent review.
Keep historical retrospective interpretations withdrawn; do not invent human approval or closure.

stories.want: root specs and one current wiki documentation home with no docs directory
stories.so: work is easy to track and readers see one current knowledge home

decisions.decision: Use root ./specs and remove docs from the workspace
decisions.because: Explicit owner instruction supersedes the old root-retention proposal.

decisions.decision: Place historical raw artifacts under specs/archive and non-concept documentation under wiki/assets
decisions.because: History stays outside active discovery; raw Markdown does not violate wiki concept/link rules.

decisions.decision: Prefer root specs exclusively; use legacy discovery only when the canonical root is absent
decisions.because: Untouched external projects remain readable without merging duplicate roots.

designs.title: Root work records and consolidated wiki documentation
designs.detail: See design.md and impact-roots.md; use relocations.json for historical source resolution.

design.approach: Use root specs for work, specs/archive for history, and wiki concepts/assets for documentation. Keep a complete relocation map and frozen closed bytes.
